from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class FinancialDataPoint(BaseModel):
    """A cash balance entry extracted from a single company's financial report."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="Name of the company the filing belongs to")
    metric_label: str | None = Field(description="The label used in the document for this cash figure (e.g. 'Cash', 'Cash and Cash Equivalents')")
    amount: float | None = Field(description="The numeric value of the cash balance reported")
    unit_scale: str | None = Field(description="The scale of the amount, e.g. 'dollars', 'thousands', 'millions'")
    report_period_end: str | None = Field(description="The date the balance sheet period ended (e.g. 'March 31, 2024')")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    financial_reports: list[FinancialDataPoint]
